lines.zh: 我背着彩色的壳，在海底爬。
lines.en: I crawl the seabed with a rainbow shell on my back.
I crawl far faster than my relatives.

lines.zh: 一道彩色的痕留在沙上。
lines.en: A colored track is left in the sand.

lines.zh: 我探出触角，先探路再走。
lines.en: I put out my feelers, scouting before I move.
Grains of sand roll away beneath my foot.
I skirt the coral without touching it.
The water is cold and my shell shines.

lines.zh: 十厘米的身子，爬得很稳。
lines.en: Ten centimeters of me, crawling steady.
I inch my way over a sea rock.
A patch of seagrass lies flattened behind me.
I climb deeper, where it is quiet.
Turning, my shell leans into the curve first.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方留着黏液。
lines.en: Slime marks everywhere I have crawled.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但从来没停过。
lines.en: I go slowly, but I have never stopped.

lines.zh: 我拖着壳翻过一道浅沟。
lines.en: I drag my shell over a shallow trench.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸高，探一探水流。
lines.en: I raise my tentacles to test the current.

lines.zh: 沙上的纹路，是我一路留下的。
lines.en: The lines in the sand are mine, all the way back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到礁石的背阴处。
lines.en: I creep into the shade behind the reef rock.

lines.zh: 我缩回壳里，只留触角在外。
lines.en: I withdraw into my shell, feelers still out.
The moon is on the wane; only then do I come out.

lines.zh: 海面很远，光落下来很淡。
lines.en: The surface is far; the light falls thin.
I have rested on the sand a long while.

lines.zh: 壳上的颜色在水里发亮。
lines.en: The colors on my shell glow in the water.
A fish swims over my head.
I turn my shell's opening slowly.
Only water sounds down here.
On the crescent moon's day I wake.
I wait for the tide to carry me.
I cling to the sea rock, cool all over.

lines.zh: 我吐出一点黏，慢慢晾着。
lines.en: I let out a little slime and let it set.
No one has come to this trench.
I sleep, and my shell stays open.
You dive down and your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的壳看，我缩了缩。
lines.en: You stare at my shell; I shrink a little.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只看见你的面罩。
lines.en: I look up and see only your mask.
You carry a bucket; I do not like it.
Your tank bubbles noisily.

lines.zh: 十厘米的螺，你也盯上了。
lines.en: A ten-centimeter snail, and you still want it.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在海里很显眼。
lines.en: My colors stand out in the sea.
To catch me you must crouch first.
I turn aside and crawl away slowly.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我缩进壳。
lines.en: Your hand reaches; I pull into my shell.
A crack runs across my shell, and it hurts.
I pull in, but the shell does not shield me.
Two hearts, gone in an instant.

lines.zh: 我滚出去老远，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I tumble far and my shell strikes stone.

lines.zh: 谁踩我？我连头都不敢出。
lines.en: Who stepped on me? I dare not show my head.

lines.zh: 黏液和血一起淌进沙里。
lines.en: Slime and blood run together into the sand.
My colors dim for a moment.
I will remember that one for a long while.
I slowly right myself and keep crawling.

lines.zh: 别打壳，壳是我唯一的家。
lines.en: Not the shell; it is my only home.

lines.zh: 你手心里那点绿的，是什么？
lines.en: What is that green thing in your palm?
Seagrass? It does not smell like it.
Lower it a bit; I can reach.
I extend a feeler and touch it.
The taste is faint; I am still deciding.
Stay still and I will crawl closer.

lines.zh: 我饿了，海底没什么可吃。
lines.en: I am hungry; there is little to eat here.
Do not pinch it; let me smell properly.
One small bite, just to taste.
That was good; do you have more?

lines.zh: 你碰了一下，我的壳翻了。
lines.en: One touch from you tips my shell over.

lines.zh: 壳磕在礁石上，咔的一声。
lines.en: My shell knocks the reef with a flat click.
I roll half a turn before righting myself.
I am this small, and you still hit me.
Your wake leaves me unsteady.
A fine crack runs along my shell.
I am shoved into the seagrass.
Do not step; a cracked shell is the end of me.
I inch aside and yield the spot.
After that bump I stayed hidden a long time.
Only on that waning night did I meet it.
Two shells knock gently together.

lines.zh: 它的壳是橘色的，比我亮。
lines.en: Its shell is orange, brighter than mine.
We crawl side by side, very slowly.
The eggs will hide on the far side of a rock.
I circle it halfway.

lines.zh: 它把腿收拢，我也跟着收。
lines.en: It draws its legs in; I draw mine in too.

lines.zh: 两股黏液在沙上合成一道。
lines.en: Two trails of slime merge into one on the sand.
A meeting like this comes once in a life.

lines.zh: 它爬走了，壳上的光还在。
lines.en: It crawls off; the light on its shell lingers.
I fold my foot around the object.
Too heavy; I drag it half a centimeter.
A shiny chip, and not edible.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在壳上，走了一段。
lines.en: I balance it on my shell a short way.
It slips off and I pick it up again.
This thing is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我把它推到礁石底下藏好。
lines.en: I push it under the reef and leave it.
I taste it; it is stone.
I push it along, inching forward.

lines.zh: 它卡在我壳口，我甩不掉。
lines.en: It jams my shell's mouth and will not shake free.

lines.zh: 前面有片海草，我要过去。
lines.en: There is seagrass ahead, and I want it.

lines.zh: 那不是猎物，是我想吃的东西。
lines.en: Not prey, just something I want to eat.
Toward that green, I slowly pick up speed.
This rotting leaf suits my taste.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，就不再改方向。
lines.en: Locked on, I will not change course.
Three centimeters away; I crawl over.

lines.zh: 有只小虾在动，我看见了。
lines.en: A little shrimp moves; I have seen it.
It is faster, so I must come from behind.

lines.zh: 我认准了这块，别的不要。
lines.en: This piece and no other.

lines.zh: 半格之内，我的腿能卷到它。
lines.en: Within half a block, my legs can reach it.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪，壳尽量不响。
lines.en: I creep along, keeping my shell quiet.
It has not noticed; I keep crawling.
I stretch my feelers to find the way.
Closer still, and I can wrap around it.
The water stirs, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我绕过海石，从侧面过去。
lines.en: I go around the rock and approach from the side.

lines.zh: 五彩的壳在水里太扎眼。
lines.en: A rainbow shell is far too conspicuous.
It backs off a step; I take one forward.

lines.zh: 我按最慢的速度靠近它。
lines.en: I close in at the slowest pace I have.
Here it is, and I open my mouth.
I scrape it once with my radula.
It springs away and my feelers retract.

lines.zh: 我压上去，整个身子盖住它。
lines.en: I press down and cover it whole.
It struggles and my shell rocks.
The blow was light, but it is frightened.
I clamp onto the root of the seagrass.
It flees, leaving only a mark.
I hold it down with my foot.
It goes down with a mouthful of sand.
Two hearts or not, I will still ram it.

lines.zh: 我是从鱼线那头被拉上来的。
lines.en: I was hauled up from the far end of a line.

lines.zh: 残月的夜里，我出现在这。
lines.en: On a waning night I appeared here.
I open my eyes on cold sea.
My shell came already grown.

lines.zh: 这么深的海，我第一次来。
lines.en: First time this deep.
I land and kick up a little sand.

lines.zh: 月亮还没圆，我不该在这。
lines.en: The moon is not full; I should not be here.
Someone in a boat reels in the line.
I retreat into my shell until the water settles.
This small patch of sand is mine.

lines.zh: 水烧起来了，我的壳在响。
lines.en: The water burns and my shell crackles.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from height, shell striking first.

lines.zh: 我在沙上干着，触角缩不回去。
lines.en: I dry out on the sand; my feelers will not retract.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得我壳里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast leaves my shell ringing.
An arrow pins straight through my shell.

lines.zh: 咒语把我从壳里拽出来。
lines.en: A spell drags me out of my shell.

lines.zh: 海草没了，我饿得壳发轻。
lines.en: No seagrass left; hunger makes my shell feel light.

lines.zh: 雷进海里，我的壳亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and my shell flares once.

lines.zh: 虚空把我连壳一起吞了。
lines.en: The void swallows me, shell and all.
